info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fooddelivery Deliveries Etas-v3-spec
info.description: The Food Delivery ETA API provides timely estimated arrival times for food delivery services. This endpoint allows users to query the estimated time of arrival for deliveries, enhancing the customer experience by providing transparent delivery timelines. Typical consumers include food delivery applications and logistics platforms that need accurate delivery forecasts to inform customers. This API is essential for ensuring effective communication and improved service quality in food delivery operations.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to obtain the estimated delivery time for a specified delivery. It's essential for planning and allows customers to track their orders efficiently.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve estimated time of arrival (ETA) for deliveries. This request may include parameters that affect the ETA calculation, such as delivery location, time of day, and other relevant details.

ListFooddeliveryDeliveriesEtasRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to ETA (Estimated Time of Arrival) for deliveries.
